title: Normalized ringed coefficient counit presentations
statement: For small sites and a geometric adjunction $f^{-1}\dashv f_*$ [def-weil-size-convention], let $A_X,A_Y$ be the constant sheaves of a commutative ring $A$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Let $R_X,R_Y,R_I=f^{-1}R_Y$ be commutative ring sheaves with algebraic inverse-image lifts [def-weil-pbc-algebraic-inverse-image], structural map $c:R_I\to R_X$, and compatible constant-coefficient algebra maps. Use the recorded module categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], coefficient restriction [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars], sheafified tensor extension [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] and unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Define OrdinaryPresentation to consist of module pullback fixed on objects and morphisms by $R_X\otimes_{R_I}f^{-1}(-)$; additive direct images equipped with natural underlying-geometric-direct-image identifications; their adjunctions fixed by the geometric Hom bijection after the sheafified map $x\mapsto1\otimes x$; and the ordinary restriction, scalar-unit and direct-image-composition comparisons fixed by these underlying identifications. Define DerivedAdjunction to record a universal left/right derived pair with its localization maps, invertible right comparison on K-injectives and the ordinary-adjunction representative Hom formula [lem-pc-pre-derived-adjoint-functors-general] [def-weil-pbc-projection-formula-arrows]. Define CoefficientExactness to record preservation of finite limits and finite colimits by the two ordinary restriction functors. Define DerivedPresentation to consist of such exactness, the two canonical derived adjunction presentations, an invertible left comparison for constant coefficients, localized coefficient restriction with its factorization isomorphisms, the invertible pullback comparison on flat-term K-flat complexes [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback], tau normalized by the localized scalar-unit map on those complexes, and kappa normalized by the K-injective composition formula using $f_*j$ [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition]. Define CounitCompatibility to be the proposition asserting the derived counit square. The square is a conclusion to be established, not a field of a presentation.
